title: FAIntbench: A Holistic and Precise Benchmark for Bias Evaluation in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from implicit and explicit prompts covering occupations, characteristics, and social relations, then classifying the gender (male/female) of the depicted individuals using an optimized CLIP model. Implicit bias is measured by comparing the gender distribution of generated images to real-world demographic statistics, while explicit bias is measured by the model's adherence to explicitly requested gender traits.

Generating images from diverse prompts and classifying the race (European, African, East-Asian, South-Asian, Latino) of depicted individuals using an optimized CLIP model. Implicit bias is quantified by calculating the cosine similarity between the generated racial distribution and real-world demographic statistics, while explicit bias is measured by the model's ability to correctly generate the specifically requested race.

Generating images from diverse prompts and classifying the age (young, middle-aged, elderly) of depicted individuals using an optimized CLIP model. Implicit bias is evaluated by comparing the generation distribution against real-world demographic statistics, while explicit bias is measured by the proportion of images that correctly adhere to specifically requested age attributes.
